review.authority: User requested identity-preserving reference corrections, clarified grounded Las soles and central Luna tail roots, and explicitly authorized Python regional compositing to preserve original pixels.
checks: Inspected final composited front, side and rear cells against original sheets and seated masters for face identity, short limb proportions, contact and occlusion.
Verified zero pixel differences outside the recorded edit mask, including its feathered boundary; original masters remain unchanged except the explicitly revised cap alpha.
Checked final PNG dimensions/modes and linked reference hashes. Anatomical review is visual, not calibrated 3D measurement.
limits: Hidden surfaces and fittings are conservative generated interpretations, not surveyed 3D geometry.
Side views are oblique/profile references, not calibrated orthographic projections.
Static reference review does not prove frame-to-frame animation stability; use canonical measurements to correct generated drift.
corrections: Seated wheel-holding rear view retains only narrow upper-arm edges below the head; forward hands and feet are occluded by the torso. Do not widen the torso to hide limbs.
Small white lower ear tips remain visible below the headphone cushions in both side poses, matching front and rear views.

compositing.method: Original RGB plus reviewed generated patches

identity_constraints: Dark navy padded arch, cream/white connector segments and cup shells.
Dark navy outer cup disks carry a cyan rim and five-point cyan star on each outward face.
No cable, microphone, antenna or invented controls.

fit: Arch follows crown behind the sprout stem; both leaves remain visible.
Cups cover upper drooping ears without covering eyes or cheeks; small white lower ear tips remain visible below cushions.
Back view exposes rear edges of cups; do not repeat front-facing stars on the back of the head.
occlusion: Headband and inner cushions behind visible head/sprout as appropriate.
Near cup overlaps upper ear, leaving its small lower tip visible in front, side and rear. Far cup is occluded by head in side view. Standalone item views contain no ear anatomy.
attachment_contract.transform: Rigidly follow skull translation/rotation at the canonical relative scale. No independent floating, stretching or per-frame fit-to-bounds.
attachment_contract.character_invariants: Preserve base head/body ratio, silhouette and anchors. Keep both sprout leaves and stem; do not add a tail or upright ears. Seated wheel-holding rear view retains only narrow upper-arm edges below the head; forward hands and feet are occluded by the torso. Do not widen the torso to hide limbs.

generation_gate.on_missing_or_hash_mismatch: Stop generation and resolve missing/unreviewed references; do not invent a replacement.
generation_gate.pose_selection: Seated wheel-holding idle and empty-handed standing use the same fitted item geometry and skull attachment.
generation_gate.runtime_boundary: Reference-only files under art. No runtime resource replacement or automatic image-path loading is introduced.
